These are public disclosures rather than proof of implementation or legal conclusions.

scope.threatModel: Incorrect scope, timing and automation claims are presented to buyers or investors as legal compliance, creating mis-selling, implementation and regulatory risk.

gaps: The repository needs a clause-by-clause matrix separating all-GPAI Article 53 duties from systemic-risk Article 55 duties, legacy model transitions, exemptions, organizational controls and technical evidence Warrantor can actually generate.

recommendation.rationale: Remove the one-command compliance and universal 2027 deadline claims immediately. The Commission states that GPAI obligations entered into application on August 2, 2025, with differentiated transition rules; Article 55 applies only to GPAI models with systemic risk and includes substantive ongoing duties no reporting tool can satisfy alone. Reframe the command as an evidence-pack generator for specified clauses, with uncovered duties and legal assumptions explicit.
alternatives: Offer a non-legal technical evidence export mapped to the Commission guidelines and GPAI Code of Practice.
Commission an EU counsel and conformity-assessment review before making any compliance demonstration claim.
Limit initial regional positioning to verified North America, India and GCC requirements while EU work remains a separate validated profile.
